description: Source code for PPP layer control in a network management system, including functions to enable/disable lower and upper PPP layers, handle IPv4/IPv6 configurations, and manage related components.

methods.name: ppp_enable_lower
methods.description: Enables the lower PPP layer for IPv4 or IPv6, setting necessary parameters and activating the interface.

methods.name: ppp_enable_upper
methods.description: Enables the upper PPP layer, including neighbor discovery and DHCPv6 client configuration for IPv6.

methods.name: ppp_disable_lower
methods.description: Disables the lower PPP layer and clears related configurations.

methods.name: ppp_disable_upper
methods.description: Disables the upper PPP layer, including neighbor discovery and DHCPv6 client.

methods.name: ppp_lower_layer
methods.description: Wrapper function to enable or disable the lower PPP layer based on the 'enable' flag.

methods.name: ppp_upper_layer
methods.description: Wrapper function to enable or disable the upper PPP layer based on the 'enable' flag.
